2026-10-16-manitoba-saskatchewan.summary: Saskatchewan can clinch a playoff berth with a win, according to the Huskies’ game notes. Both teams return from the Canada West bye week, with Manitoba coming off an 18–3 win over Alberta and Saskatchewan having beaten UBC 34–24.

2026-10-16-calgary-ubc.summary: Calgary won the season opener 23–7. UBC’s preview points to receiver Matt Sibley as a major threat for the Dinos, while the Thunderbirds will look to their running game to help turn the rematch their way.
